title: Which way?
text: You're facing an attacker in the middle of the pitch. They could go either way.
tip: Pick a side and show them where you want them to go.

options.text: Stand side-on and push them to the touchline
options.why: The wing is less dangerous, and the touchline acts like an extra defender.
Inside is the shortest route to goal and opens up a shot.

options.text: Stand square in front of them
options.why: Better than nothing, but they can go either way past you.
